404 page

Web·by @dqnamo·2026-08-29·inspora page·original post

What it is

404 page as a toy: 'Pocket Arcade' - a chunky retro handheld console center-page playing tiny games on its screen (invaders, snake, pong) while game cartridges float and bob around it; the screen glitches between games.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Page header 'Pocket Arcade' + 404 copy; dark handheld console (D-pad, red button, speaker grille) center; 3-4 cartridge sprites floating at angles around it; screen shows boot text.
15-40%
Screen plays a space-invaders-like: rows of alien pixels, player ship firing; cartridges bob gently (translateY sine, slight rotation).
40-60%
Screen glitches (scanline tear) and switches to snake: pixel snake grows as it eats dots.
60-85%
Switches to pong/brick-breaker: paddle + ball; cartridges keep drifting; one cartridge occasionally 'docks' toward the console slot.
85-100%
Back to invaders; loop.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a 404 page as a toy - "Pocket Arcade": a chunky retro handheld console center-page playing tiny games on its screen (invaders, snake, pong) while game cartridges float and bob around it. The screen glitches between games.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Page header "Pocket Arcade" + 404 copy. Center: dark handheld console (D-pad, red button, speaker grille). Around it: 3-4 cartridge sprites floating at angles. The console screen starts on boot text.

## Motion spec
Pattern: ambient toy loop.
- Games: the screen plays a space-invaders-like (alien rows, ship firing), then snake (grows as it eats), then pong/brick-breaker (paddle + ball) - each ~6s, rendered as chunky pixels with stepped motion (no interpolation).
- Game switch: 300ms screen glitch (scanline tear / horizontal displacement slices) between titles.
- Cartridges: gentle bob - translateY sine over 3-5s with slight rotation, each on its own phase; occasionally one cartridge "docks" toward the console slot and drifts back.
- Page copy and console body: perfectly still.

## Calibration
- Bob amplitude small (6-10px) and slow (3-5s); cartridges are floating, not bouncing.
- Glitch 300ms max - a tear, not a light show.
- Pixel games update at low frame cadence (10-15fps feel); smooth modern motion would break the retro read.

## Reduced motion
Screen shows a static game frame per title (swapping every 6s with a 150ms fade); cartridges still.

## Don't miss
- The screen is a real little canvas running game logic - not a video; the charm is that it plays.
- The glitch is the transition language between games; no crossfades.
- One cartridge occasionally docking toward the slot is the detail people screenshot.
